[name="月见夜"]今天的训练就到此为止吧。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_2107_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="随从武士"]将军辛苦了！请好好休息吧。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_2101_1#4$1",focus="m")]
[name="月见夜"]两位“异兽猎人”还在斑弥罗的工坊吗？
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_2107_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="随从武士"]是的。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_2101_1#6$1",focus="m")]
[name="月见夜"]正好，有一段时间没去他那里了，我去看看他的发明怎么样了。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_2101_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="月见夜"]你们回去之后也不要怠于训练。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_2107_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="随从武士"]是！
[Dialog]
[Blocker(a=0, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=0, block=true)]
[Blocker(a=1, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=2, block=true)]
[Dialog]
[charslot]
[Background(image="71_g1_impermanence_street",screenadapt="coverall")]
[Delay(time=2)]
[Blocker(a=0, r=0, g=0, b=0, fadetime=2, block=true)]
[Delay(time=1)]
[charslot(slot="l",name="avg_npc_2100_1#5$1",duration=1.5,afrom=0,ato=1)]
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_npc_2101_1#2$1",duration=1.5,afrom=0,ato=1)]
[Delay(time=2)]
[charslot(slot="l",name="avg_npc_2100_1#5$1",focus="l")]
[name="宝巫迦"]月见夜？
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_npc_2101_1#2$1",focus="r")]
[name="月见夜"]陛下？
[charslot(slot="l",name="avg_npc_2100_1#5$1")]
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_npc_2101_1#2$1")]
[name="宝巫迦&月见夜"]为什么你/您会……
[charslot(slot="l",name="avg_npc_2100_1#1$1")]
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_npc_2101_1#1$1")]
[name="宝巫迦&月见夜"]吾/我是来找两位“异兽猎人”……
[Dialog]
[charslot(slot="l",name="avg_npc_2100_1#5$1")]
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_npc_2101_1#2$1")]
[Delay(time=1)]
[charslot(slot="l",name="avg_npc_2100_1#1$1")]
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_npc_2101_1#1$1")]
[name="宝巫迦&月见夜"]既然你/您找她们有事，那吾/我——
[Dialog]
[charslot(slot="l",name="avg_npc_2100_1#5$1")]
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_npc_2101_1#2$1")]
[Delay(time=1)]
[charslot(slot="l",name="avg_npc_2100_1#4$1")]
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_npc_2101_1#6$1")]
[name="宝巫迦&月见夜"]……
[charslot(slot="l",name="avg_npc_2100_1#8$1",focus="l")]
[name="宝巫迦"]不知将军找“异兽猎人”有何贵干？
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_npc_2101_1#1$1",focus="r")]
[name="月见夜"]回禀陛下，“异兽猎人”的武器需要特别打造，我担心斑弥罗办事不力，特来督促。
[name="月见夜"]陛下只需要在宫中安心等待两位做好准备即可，无需挂怀。
[charslot(slot="l",name="avg_npc_2100_1#4$1",focus="l")]
[name="宝巫迦"]将军大人言重了。
[charslot(slot="l",name="avg_npc_2100_1#1$1",focus="l")]
[name="宝巫迦"]此番试炼，“异兽猎人”是吾之臂膀，她们的装备自有吾来准备，不劳将军大人费心才是。
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_npc_2101_1#4$1",focus="r")]
[name="月见夜"]陛下日理万机，这点小事交给我来就好。
[charslot(slot="l",name="avg_npc_2100_1#1$1",focus="l")]
[name="宝巫迦"]将军为了狩猎团日夜操劳，合该多加休息才对。
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_npc_2101_1#9$1",focus="r")]
[name="月见夜"]……
[charslot(slot="l",name="avg_npc_2100_1#8$1",focus="l")]
[name="宝巫迦"]……
[charslot]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_2103_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="斑弥罗"]吵什么吵，今天我家怎么这么热闹？
[name="斑弥罗"]咦，陛下？您怎么也来了？
[name="斑弥罗"]还有月见夜，我先说好，你要的那批武器没那么快。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_2101_1#5$1",focus="m")]
[name="月见夜"]我知道，我不是为这个来的，只是来看看老友而已。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_2103_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="斑弥罗"]别恶心我。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_2100_1#4$1",focus="m")]
[name="宝巫迦"]梓兰小姐和空爆小姐人呢？
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_2103_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="斑弥罗"]她们正在后院的竹林里训练。
[charslot]
[charslot(slot="l",name="avg_npc_2100_1#4$1")]
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_npc_2101_1#6$1")]
[name="宝巫迦&月见夜"]……
[charslot]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_2103_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="斑弥罗"]你也是为她们来的？
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_2101_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="月见夜"]算是吧。
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_2103_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="斑弥罗"]那你们正好去劝劝她们，我怕她们把我后院的竹子全砍完了。
[charslot]
[charslot(slot="l",name="avg_npc_2100_1#1$1")]
[charslot(slot="r",name="avg_npc_2101_1#1$1")]
[name="宝巫迦&月见夜"]不必了，吾/我就在这里等到她们训练结束。
[charslot]
[charslot(slot="m",name="avg_npc_2103_1#1$1",focus="m")]
[name="斑弥罗"]……
[name="斑弥罗"]呃，你们一定要等的话，要不我给你们搬张椅子来？
